description: Evans double-pair comparison risk ratios (x=1 vs x=0) for driver / right-front passenger pairs (belts; age 65+ vs 25-44 and female vs male among both-belted pairs) and motorcycle operator / passenger pairs (helmet); misreport_fraction > 0 = closed-form reclassification of a fraction of 'belted' survivors to unbelted
population: FARS 2016-2024 vehicles with exactly one eligible driver (seat 11) and one eligible right-front passenger (seat 13) / motorcycles with one operator and one passenger
method: Four component ratios of death ratios and their inverse-variance weighted geometric mean; percentile bootstrap over vehicles (exact multinomial on 16 cells, 2000 replicates) and over crashes
